verdict.rationale: incident.io offers its own headless interfaces: a public REST API authenticated with dashboard-issued API keys, with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec. It also has a first-party Terraform provider for infrastructure-as-code, a Status Page API for programmatic incident and maintenance management, and custom HTTP alert sources. Together these let automation drive the product without the UI, but there is no documented CLI or CI-specific integration. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration (e.g. a pipeline action), documented CI/headless usage guides, and independent hands-on corroboration of automation in CI.
